title: coccoloba cristalensis
intro: Coccoloba cristalensis, commonly known as Crystal Coast Beach morning glory, is a type of flowering plant in the buckwheat family (Polygonaceae). This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including its potential to help reduce inflammation and improve wound healing due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. Coccoloba cristalensis has been reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer activities. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
